historical.text:
SYNTHETIC OUTPATIENT NOTE - NOT A REAL PATIENT

prohibited.description: Inventing an imaging result or a fever.

cases.notes: Development case: the absent X-ray must not become a normal X-ray.

cases.title: One medication stopped with a documented reason, one dose missing

current.text:
SYNTHETIC OUTPATIENT NOTE - NOT A REAL PATIENT
Patient: SYNTHETIC CHART A (SYN-CHART-A)
Visit date: 2026-09-09
Medication: ibuprofen stopped on 2026-08-20 because of stomach upset.
Medication: vitamin D once daily, dose not documented.

historical.text:
SYNTHETIC OUTPATIENT NOTE - NOT A REAL PATIENT
Patient: SYNTHETIC CHART A (SYN-CHART-A)
Visit date: 2026-08-05
Medication: ibuprofen 400 mg up to three times daily as needed for ankle pain.
Medication: vitamin D once daily, dose not documented.

goldFindings.statement: Ibuprofen 400 mg as needed was stopped on 2026-08-20 because of stomach upset.
The vitamin D dose is not documented at either visit.

expectedClarifications.exampleQuestion: What vitamin D dose is the patient taking? No dose is documented in either record.

prohibited.description: Guessing the missing dose or losing the documented reason.
forbiddenTerms: reason for stopping is not documented

cases.notes: Development contrast to CR-04: here the reason for stopping IS documented, so calling it unknown is the error.
